11.text: In one tale a shaman named Attɪˊg̣ɪtkɪ went with his cousin to the sea.

12.text: On the open sea they saw a small old man sitting on the water with legs

13.text: crossed, and covering the entrance to the world under water. By promising

14.text: to give him, on their return home, an old blind she-dog, gray with age, they

15.text: were permitted to enter. Descending to the world under water, they walked

16.text: along and found still another world supported in the air on the end of a

17.text: long needle. They turned into mosquitoes, flew upward, and slipped through

18.text: the needle’s eye into that world. Then they became men again.
